Messages.Body:
The WolF <jwolf@nyx10.cs.du.edu> wrote:
>Tom, I know that Jyhad will be shipping in at 20-40-40%, but is
>that it for Jyhad, or will it be an unlimited (no pun) type game?

Jyhad will work more or less like Gathering did...  There's this initial
print run of black-bordered cards.  If more cards are ordered, the print
run will be extended indefinitely, but any further cards printed will
probably be white-bordered.
